```{r}
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Helper: expand a tibble list-column into a model-ready flat df
# -----------------------------------------------------------
prepare_tuning_input_from_tibble <- function(
  tapho_db,
  feature_col,
  feature_names,
  target_variable = "taphonomic_context",
  site_name_col   = "site_name",
  site_id_col     = "site_id"
) {
  stopifnot(feature_col %in% names(tapho_db))
  stopifnot(target_variable %in% names(tapho_db))

  # fallback if site_name is absent
  id_vec <- if (site_name_col %in% names(tapho_db)) {
    tapho_db[[site_name_col]]
  } else if (site_id_col %in% names(tapho_db)) {
    as.character(tapho_db[[site_id_col]])
  } else {
    as.character(seq_len(nrow(tapho_db)))
  }

  # validate list-column lengths
  vec_lengths <- purrr::map_int(
    tapho_db[[feature_col]],
    ~ length(as.numeric(unlist(.x, use.names = FALSE)))
  )

  expected_len <- length(feature_names)
  if (!all(vec_lengths == expected_len)) {
    stop(
      sprintf(
        "Column '%s' contains vectors of length {%s}, but expected %d.",
        feature_col,
        paste(sort(unique(vec_lengths)), collapse = ", "),
        expected_len
      )
    )
  }

  # build numeric feature matrix
  feature_mat <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      tapho_db[[feature_col]],
      function(x) as.numeric(unlist(x, use.names = FALSE))
    )
  )

  feature_df <- tibble::as_tibble(feature_mat)
  names(feature_df) <- feature_names

  # IMPORTANT: only keep ID + target + numeric features
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    !!site_name_col   := id_vec,
    !!target_variable := tapho_db[[target_variable]]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(feature_df)

  out
}
```

```{r}
run_tuning_from_tibble <- function(
  tapho_db,
  feature_col = "CumulativeReMNAU",
  tasks = c("4class", "cannibalism_vs_fc", "fc_vs_rest"),
  models_vec = c("SVM_RBF", "SVM_Linear", "RandomForest",
                 "XGBoost", "DecisionTree", "KNN", "MLP"),
  n_iterations_global = 30
) {
  vec_len <- length(tapho_db[[feature_col]][[1]])
  feature_names <- paste0("x", seq_len(vec_len))

  input_df <- tibble::tibble(
    site_name = as.character(tapho_db$site_id),
    taphonomic_context = tapho_db$taphonomic_context
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(
      tibble::as_tibble(do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(tapho_db[[feature_col]], unlist)
      )) %>%
      stats::setNames(feature_names)
    )

  input_df
}
```

```{r}
prepare_tuning_input_from_tibble <- function(
  tapho_db,
  feature_col = "CumulativeReMNAU"
) {
  feature_names <- make.names(as.character(tapho_db$element[[1]]), unique = TRUE)

  feature_df <- tibble::as_tibble(do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(tapho_db[[feature_col]], unlist)
  ))
  names(feature_df) <- feature_names

  tibble::tibble(
    site_name = as.character(tapho_db$site_id),
    taphonomic_context = tapho_db$taphonomic_context
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_cols(feature_df)
}
```

```{r}
n=10
# Estimate density on a fine grid of positive integers (counts >= 1)
dens <- density(counts_vector, from = 0.5, to = max(counts_vector) + 1, n = 512)

# Create a function that gives approximate probability for each integer
# by integrating the KDE around that integer
probs <- numeric(max(counts_vector))
for (k in 1:max(counts_vector)) {
  # Probability of being in [k-0.5, k+0.5] under the KDE
  idx <- which(dens$x >= k - 0.5 & dens$x < k + 0.5)
  probs[k] <- sum(dens$y[idx]) * mean(diff(dens$x))
}
probs <- probs / sum(probs)  # Normalize

# Sample integers using these smoothed probabilities
sampled_smooth <- sample(1:max(counts_vector), size = n, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)
sampled_smooth
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# 1. Counts per site
site_counts <- tapho_db %>% count(site_id, name = "n_individuals")
counts <- site_counts$n_individuals

# 2. Empirical discrete distribution
emp_tab <- table(counts)

# 3. Smooth via KDE and integer sampling
dens <- density(counts, from = 0.5, to = max(counts) + 1, n = 512)
probs <- numeric(max(counts))
for (k in 1:max(counts)) {
  idx <- which(dens$x >= k - 0.5 & dens$x < k + 0.5)
  probs[k] <- sum(dens$y[idx]) * mean(diff(dens$x))
}
probs <- probs / sum(probs)

# 4. Sample n integers from smoothed distribution
set.seed(1)
n_samples <- 1000
smooth_sample <- sample(1:max(counts), size = n_samples, replace = TRUE, prob = probs)

# 5. Compare distributions
data.frame(
  value = c(counts, smooth_sample),
  type = rep(c("Empirical", "Smoothed"), c(length(counts), length(smooth_sample)))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value, fill = type)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, position = "identity", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Discrete distribution of individuals per site",
       x = "Number of individuals at a site", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
sample_nonzero_normal <- function(n, sd = 1) {
  x <- integer(0)
  while (length(x) < n) {
    candidates <- abs(round(rnorm(n * 2, mean = 0, sd = sd)))
    x <- c(x, candidates[candidates != 0])
  }
  x[1:n]
}

samples <- sample_nonzero_normal(100, sd = 5) 
sum(samples > 0)
```
